reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1 skipped: missing-validation finding (fee never deducted) and public API exception applies. Gate 2: entry point is untrusted external user; no trust_assumptions in scope file. Gate 3: borrow.move is explicitly in-scope. An attacker can trigger this via the public borrow() entry point by calling it with any borrow_amount, causing the protocol to return the full amount with zero fee deduction, bypassing the mandatory 0.3%/1% borrow fee and causing complete loss of borrow fee revenue.
